card.name: Inside the word reconstitute
card.fires_on: The middle pieces of the word "reconstitute" or "reconstituted" (re-const-it-ute) in preparation instructions for injectable drugs. Also the number before "0 mL" of diluent in reconstitution steps.

modes.description: The "it" or "const" piece inside reconstitute/reconstituted in drug preparation directions.
